# Foreign data wrapper options

_Generated from `extension/src/options.rs` and `extension/src/import.rs`. Edit those files and run `make docs-generate`; CI fails on an uncommitted difference._

These are every option the validator accepts. An option not listed for a statement is rejected at DDL time, naming the statement and the offending option, rather than being ignored.

## `CREATE SERVER`

`CREATE SERVER ... OPTIONS` — how to reach a gateway.

| Option | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `endpoint` | **yes** | _(none)_ | gateway address as an https URL, e.g. https://axiom-gateway:8443; plaintext is refused because the connection carries cluster data |
| `ca_cert` | no | `the host trust store` | path, readable by the Postgres server process, to the PEM CA bundle that signs the gateway certificate |
| `rpc_timeout_secs` | no | `30` | per-RPC deadline in whole seconds, greater than zero; a whole-cluster IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA can need more than the default |

## `CREATE FOREIGN TABLE`

`CREATE FOREIGN TABLE ... OPTIONS` — which kind a table maps to.

| Option | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resource` | **yes** | _(none)_ | plural resource name, e.g. pods; sufficient on its own for the built-in kinds |
| `group` | no | `"" (the core API group)` | API group of the kind, e.g. apps or example.com |
| `version` | no | _(none)_ | API version, e.g. v1; required together with kind for any kind that is not built in |
| `kind` | no | _(none)_ | singular CamelCase kind, e.g. Widget; required together with version for any kind that is not built in |
| `namespaced` | no | `true` | whether the kind is namespaced; false makes the namespace column meaningless and it is omitted from generated DDL |
| `writable` | no | `false for built-in read-only kinds, true otherwise` | whether INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE are offered; cannot be turned on for kinds the extension keeps read-only, such as Pods |
| `cache_mode` | no | `on_demand` | on_demand serves every scan by RPC; watch serves scans from the watch-driven cache and starts a subscription for the kind |

## `IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA`

`IMPORT FOREIGN SCHEMA ... OPTIONS` — how a whole schema is generated.

| Option | Required | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cache_mode` | no | `on_demand` | applied to every generated table, and silently downgraded to on_demand for a kind the API server will not let the gateway watch |
| `prefix` | no | `"" (no prefix)` | prepended to every generated table name, so two clusters can be imported into one schema without colliding |

## `CREATE FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER` and `CREATE USER MAPPING`

Neither accepts any option today, and both reject any that is given. The wrapper carries no configuration of its own, and per-caller credentials on a user mapping arrive in Phase 7 (see `docs/AUTH.md`).
